title: Studio Production schema has no native geospatial output kind
workflow: GeoPackage creative work -> Production registration -> schema validation
symptom: The first production descriptor used kind=geospatial and failed JSON Schema validation; the schema currently enumerates article/video/audio/image/captions/interactive/publication-package only.
expected_behavior: A GeoPackage-bearing creative work should be representable without inventing a new parallel Production schema.
actual_behavior: The work must currently classify the GeoPackage as the broader publication-package output kind while preserving exact .gpkg format identity in the Work catalog/provenance layer.
proposed_fix: Only if repeated real productions justify it, extend the existing output-kind vocabulary minimally; do not create a second geospatial production schema.
fix_attempt: Used existing publication-package as the bounded current classification and retained .gpkg identity elsewhere.
verification: Current production descriptor validates under the existing schema after the bounded adaptation.
